يستنتجوا (form X)
# يَسْتَنْتِجُوا (yastantijū) /jas.tan.ti.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْتَجَ (istantaja)
# يُسْتَنْتَجُوا (yustantajū) /jus.tan.ta.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْتَجَ (istantaja)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
